statusDescription: You now have a clean dark mode setup with persisted theme preference.

cookieConsent.title: Save your progress on this device?
cookieConsent.lead: SpillArena stores a few small things in your browser so you stay signed in and your progress follows you between the games.
cookieConsent.scope: Your answer applies to all of SpillArena – the front page and every game.

without.signin: You aren't remembered. You have to sign in again every time you open a game or reload the page.
without.progress: If you play without signing in, your XP, levels and records are gone when you close the tab.
without.results: Rounds you play while signed out aren't posted under your name on the leaderboards.
without.settings: Theme, accent color and language reset on every visit.

cookieConsent.storedTitle: What is stored in your browser

session.title: Keeps you signed in
session.body: Your username and a sign-in key that lasts up to 30 days, so you don't have to sign in again in every game. Your PIN is never stored here.

settings.title: Your settings
settings.body: Whether you chose light or dark mode, your favourite color and your language.

choice.title: Your answer to this question
choice.body: Whether you said yes or no, so we don't ask again. This is saved even if you decline.

cookieConsent.server: Only if you create an account, this is also saved on our server: your username, a protected version of your PIN that nobody can read, and your progress in each game.
cookieConsent.noTracking: No ads, no tracking, and nothing is shared with third parties.
cookieConsent.manage: See what is stored and change your choice
cookieConsent.statusAccepted: Your sign-in and settings are saved on this device, so your progress and results follow your account.
cookieConsent.statusDeclined: Nothing is saved on this device. You have to sign in again each visit; while signed in, progress and results are saved to your account.
cookieConsent.statusUndecided: You haven't made a choice yet.

account.title: Account
account.pinHint: 4–6 digits. It works across every game.
account.blurb: One account for all of SpillArena. Your progress follows you between the games.
account.noConsent: Storage is off, so you're only signed in until you leave this page. In a game you can sign in again from the badge in the corner — your progress and results are then saved to your account.
account.switchToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in.

errors.not_configured: Accounts are unavailable right now. You can keep playing as a guest.

account.renameWarning: Scores you have already posted keep the old name. The leaderboards live in each game and do not follow the change.

recovery.title: Forgot PIN
recovery.intro: Enter your recovery code, or the one-time code an admin gave you, and choose a new PIN.
recovery.codeHint: 12 characters from when you saved it, or 8 from an admin. Upper or lower case doesn't matter.
recovery.noCode: No code? Ask an admin for a one-time code. It lasts one day.
recovery.badCode: Wrong username or code, or the code has been used or has expired.
recovery.saveIntro: If you forget your PIN, this is the code that gets you back in. It is only shown now, and works once — then you get a new one.
recovery.confirmSaved: I have saved the code somewhere safe
recovery.missing: You don't have a recovery code. Make one now, while you remember your PIN — otherwise you'll need an admin's help if you forget it.
recovery.createIntro: With the code you can choose a new PIN yourself if you forget it.
recovery.replaceWarning: The code you already have stops working.

admin.title: Admin panel
admin.gamesNote: Accounts that have saved progress in the game. The bar is the share of all accounts.

actions.banHelp: The player is signed out of SpillArena and can't sign in again. The name stays taken, so it can't be registered again.
actions.renameHelp: The player is signed out and signs in again with the new name. Scores already posted keep the old name.
actions.deleteHelp: Deletes the account and all saved progress. This can't be undone.
actions.selfHint: This is your own account. Change it from the account menu.
actions.adminHint: Admins can't be banned, renamed, deleted or given a one-time code. Admin rights are removed in the database, not here.
actions.resetCodeTitle: One-time code for a new PIN
actions.resetCodeHelp: Give the code to the player. They choose "Forgot your PIN?", enter their username and the code, and pick a new PIN themselves. The code works once and expires {{date}}. It is only shown now — making a new one stops this one working.

progress.none: Hasn't saved progress in any game.
progress.unreadable: The saved data can't be read.
